projects.name: Two-branch campus network (graduation project)
projects.description: Planned IP addressing for 1,200 hosts across 14 departments by subnetting a /20 block, separated departments at layer 2 with trunked links between access and distribution layers, routed between them on a layer-3 switch, ran OSPF in two areas with failover testing, connected branches via an encrypted IPsec tunnel over a simulated ISP, implemented centralized DHCP with relays, and documented the topology and address plan in Visio with a change log. Built first in Packet Tracer then implemented on six real Cisco 2960 and ISR devices.
